maya: Heads up — saw requests hit the master route but header `x-team` and `x-corr-id` present; decision log shows match: fallback-route and `overrides_applied: false`. Sampling marked this request as sampled=true but the evaluation trace doesn't include the header-override step. anyone seen this?
sam: pinging @infra to check decision-log sampling mapping. any quick logs we can look at?
infra-bot: decision-log-id=dl_0a9f sample_bucket=42 correlator=hdr-corr-7 stored -> s3://redwood-logs/decisions/2026/03/27/dl_0a9f.json
maya: pasting a minimal decision-log snippet i pulled:
```
route_id: fallback-route
matched_rules: []
headers_seen: ["x-team", "x-corr-id"]
overrides_applied: false
```
anya: this smells like the sampler key doesn't include the normalized header. sampling runs pre-normalization for perf, so if normalization rewrites `x-corr-id` -> `x-corr` the sample_key and eval_key can diverge. cc @leo
leo: confirmed. pipeline is: ingress -> header-normalize -> sampling -> rule-eval. sampling currently runs before normalize to avoid extra allocations. result: sampler sees raw header names, later normalize changes names and override matching uses normalized names -> mismatch.
sam: oof. options: move sampling after normalization (perf hit), or ensure sampler sees both raw + normalized header names (cheap copy).
maya: simplest quick patch: copy raw->normalized header before sampling if present, e.g. `if x-corr-id present set x-corr` so sampler picks it up. canary it first.
anya: agree, but watch cardinality. adding another header to sample key increases cardinality exposure. propose we gate behind a feature flag and emit metric `decision_log_missing_header_override_rate` to measure before/after.
leo: also add `sample_key_snapshot` into decision log schema (small string) so future debugging can show exactly what key was used to pick the sample. avoids full trace capture.
maya: opened PR to infra: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4242 — introduces `sampler.copy_normalized_headers=true` toggle and the `sample_key_snapshot` field. will canary on staging.
sam: can we also add a Console dashboard tile that filters sampled decisions where `overrides_applied==false` AND `headers_seen` contains `x-team` so product can see counts per route? it'd help catch regressions quickly.
anya: add an alert too: if `decision_log_missing_header_override_rate` > 0.5% above baseline for any route over a 1h window, send to #incidents-eng-platform and page on P1.
leo: long-term: we need a contract between normalization and sampling. sampling keys should be derived from a stable set of canonical header names, not ad-hoc. create an RFC issue for that.
maya: ack, i'll file the RFC and a follow-up tracking task. i'll also attach a small replay harness to the canary so we can re-run sampled requests through post-normalize eval for validation. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: staged canary deploy started by maya for infra/sampler v1.2.3 — canary=5% -> stable if no regressions in 2h
maya: thanks — i'll monitor metrics and post updates. planning 48h canary with dashboard + alert on.
